Contributing

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Use R for implementation, automation, benchmarks and supporting analysis. Quote package names in every library() call. Follow tidyverse style, keep functions pipeable with data first, and document public arguments with roxygen2.

Install development dependencies, then run:

roxygen2::roxygenise()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()
pkgdown::build_site()

Tests compare membership with independently computed sets and statistical criteria with exact Gaussian refits. Keep simulations and million-observation benchmarks in benchmarks/, outside routine CRAN tests. When reporting check results, name any options that caused skipped validation or expected notes.

An optional package belongs in Suggests. Check availability with a clear error before using it; never attach it as a side effect. Do not silently reorder model observations, repair geometry, fill time gaps, change global spatial options, change the caller’s RNG for an explicit seed, or reinterpret keys as independence.

Release notes classify new capabilities under New features, changes to existing behaviour under User visible changes, and corrections under Bug fixes. Amend an existing unreleased feature entry when completing it; record each change once.

Developed by Gavin L. Simpson.
